symbols.name: Resistor
symbols.note: Zigzag form, used in US and most hobby schematics.

symbols.name: Resistor (IEC)
symbols.note: Rectangle form, used in Europe.

symbols.name: Potentiometer
symbols.note: Resistor with a wiper arrow. Also used for trimmers.

symbols.name: Thermistor
symbols.note: Resistor crossed by a bent line: value changes with temperature.

symbols.name: Fuse
symbols.note: Rectangle with the conductor running through it.

symbols.name: Capacitor
symbols.note: Two parallel plates. Ceramic, film, any non-polarised type.

symbols.name: Electrolytic
symbols.note: Polarised: straight plate is +, curved plate is −.

symbols.name: Inductor
symbols.note: Coil of four turns. Chokes, ferrite inductors.

symbols.name: Crystal
symbols.note: Quartz slab between two plates.

symbols.name: Diode
symbols.note: Triangle points to the bar, the cathode.

symbols.name: Zener diode
symbols.note: Cathode bar with bent ends.

symbols.name: Schottky diode
symbols.note: Cathode bar with S-shaped hooks.

symbols.name: LED
symbols.note: Diode with two arrows pointing away: light out.

symbols.name: NPN transistor
symbols.note: Bipolar. Emitter arrow points out.

symbols.name: PNP transistor
symbols.note: Bipolar. Emitter arrow points in.

symbols.name: N-channel MOSFET
symbols.note: Enhancement mode. Arrow points into the channel.

symbols.name: P-channel MOSFET
symbols.note: Enhancement mode. Arrow points out of the channel.

symbols.name: Op-amp
symbols.note: Triangle with inverting (−) and non-inverting (+) inputs.

symbols.name: Integrated circuit
symbols.note: Generic block for any chip: timers, regulators, MCUs.

symbols.name: Switch
symbols.note: Single pole, single throw. Toggle and slide switches.

symbols.name: Push button
symbols.note: Normally open, momentary.

symbols.name: Relay
symbols.note: Coil on the left, linked contact on the right.

symbols.name: Battery
symbols.note: Long plate +, short plate −. Two cells shown.

symbols.name: Speaker
symbols.note: Magnet and cone. Dynamic speakers and passive buzzers.

symbols.name: Motor
symbols.note: Circle with M.

symbols.name: TVS diode
symbols.note: Bidirectional transient suppressor: two Zeners back to back.

symbols.name: Bridge rectifier
symbols.note: Four diodes in a diamond. AC in top and bottom, DC out left (−) and right (+).

symbols.name: Varistor (MOV)
symbols.note: Resistor crossed by a line bent at both ends: clamps voltage spikes.

symbols.name: Photoresistor (LDR)
symbols.note: Resistor with light arrows pointing in.

symbols.name: Photodiode
symbols.note: Diode with light arrows pointing in.

symbols.name: Phototransistor
symbols.note: NPN without a base lead. Light is the base current.

symbols.name: Optocoupler
symbols.note: LED and phototransistor in one package: isolates two circuits.

symbols.name: Thyristor (SCR)
symbols.note: Diode with a gate on the cathode side. Latches on until current stops.

symbols.name: Triac
symbols.note: Two thyristors in anti-parallel with one gate. AC switching.

symbols.name: Ferrite bead
symbols.note: Wire through a tilted block. Impedance is given at 100 MHz.

symbols.name: Transformer
symbols.note: Two coils with an iron core between them.

symbols.name: Trimmer
symbols.note: Preset resistor. The wiper ends in a bar: set once with a screwdriver.

symbols.name: Rotary encoder
symbols.note: Knob with A, C, B pins. Counts steps in either direction.

symbols.name: DIP switch
symbols.note: A row of slide switches in one block.

symbols.name: Buzzer
symbols.note: Half-dome on two leads. Active buzzers have the + mark.

symbols.name: Voltage regulator
symbols.note: Block with in, out and ground. Linear or switching.

packages.name: Axial
packages.note: Resistors and some caps. Leads out of both ends.

packages.name: Axial diode
packages.note: Glass DO-35 or plastic DO-41. Band marks the cathode.

packages.name: Radial can
packages.note: Electrolytic. Stripe marks −, longer leg is +.

packages.name: Ceramic disc
packages.note: Ceramic caps, NTC thermistors, varistors.

packages.name: Box film
packages.note: Film capacitors. Rectangular block, two legs.

packages.name: TO-92
packages.note: Small transistors and regulators. Flat face forward.

packages.name: TO-220
packages.note: Power transistors and regulators. Metal tab with a hole.

packages.name: DIP
packages.note: Dual in-line, top view. Notch and dot mark pin 1.

packages.name: 5 mm LED
packages.note: Domed lens, flange, longer leg is the anode.

packages.name: HC-49
packages.note: Crystal in a low metal can.

packages.name: Tactile switch
packages.note: Top view: square body, round plunger, four legs.

packages.name: Chip
packages.note: Resistors, caps, ferrite beads. 0402 to 2512.

packages.name: SOD / SMA
packages.note: Diode body with cathode band, flat leads.

packages.name: SOT-23
packages.note: Three-lead small transistor package, top view.

packages.name: SOT-223
packages.note: Regulators like AMS1117. Wide tab, three leads.

packages.name: SOIC
packages.note: Gull-wing leads on two sides. Dot marks pin 1.

packages.name: QFP
packages.note: Leads on all four sides. Microcontrollers.

packages.name: QFN
packages.note: No leads. Bottom view: edge pads and a thermal pad.

packages.name: SMD electrolytic
packages.note: Top view. Dark segment marks −, chamfered base is +.

packages.name: DPAK
packages.note: TO-252 power package. Tab soldered to the board.

packages.name: Power inductor
packages.note: Shielded square body with a round core.

packages.name: TO-247
packages.note: Large power package. Mounting hole through the body.

packages.name: SIP network
packages.note: Resistor network in a single row. Dot marks the common pin.

packages.name: 7-segment display
packages.note: Front view. Seven bars and a decimal point.

packages.name: SOT-89
packages.note: Small power package. The middle lead runs through as a tab.

packages.name: SOT-23-6
packages.note: Five or six leads. LDOs, small logic, MOSFET pairs.

packages.name: D²PAK
packages.note: TO-263. Bigger DPAK for power MOSFETs and regulators.

packages.name: MELF
packages.note: Cylindrical SMD body with metal end caps.

packages.name: TSSOP / MSOP
packages.note: Thin, fine-pitch version of SOIC.

packages.name: BGA
packages.note: Bottom view. Ball grid, chamfer marks A1.

packages.name: SMD LED
packages.note: PLCC style. Round lens, cut corner marks the cathode.

packages.name: SMD crystal
packages.note: Metal lid on a ceramic base. 3.2 × 2.5 mm and up.

packages.name: 18650 cell
packages.note: Li-ion cylinder, 18 × 65 mm. Button end is +.

packages.name: Coin cell
packages.note: Lithium coin cell, + side up.
